meta.notes: A cat variant: asset_id is the grown cat's texture (64 by 32 pixels) and baby_asset_id the kitten's (32 by 32), under textures/entity/cat/. One spawn condition with priority 0 and no condition puts it among the vanilla cats wherever cats spawn, in villages and swamp huts. Try /summon minecraft:cat ~ ~ ~ {variant:"msm_examples:ruby_cat"}.
